research_notes: Initial research 2026-10-01: frozen occupation extract, indexed APH biography, complete first speech reproduction, personal biography and ABS historical Hydro account reviewed. Official roster unchanged.

Early full-time job employer and dates unresolved. Secondary Wikipedia lead cites Rachel Clun, Sydney Morning Herald, 19 September 2023, https://www.smh.com.au/politics/federal/some-people-start-from-a-long-way-behind-affordable-housing-is-personal-for-julie-collins-20230915-p5e4vv.html; direct retrieval returned cannot be opened (non-retryable error). Do not promote its supermarket continuity claim without reading corroborating evidence. Same-name Woolworths professional profile not identity matched and not used.

DTPHA Ministerial Unit classification requires a contemporary establishment/appointment record. Searches for 2003–05 annual reports and government directory did not resolve it. Tasmanian Times 2006-01 record-level-of-special-jobs-for-labors-special-friends indexed page names Manager Secretariat and cites 2003 directory/ministerial staff lists; page presented bot wall. Political commentary and ambiguous salary not accepted as appointment or hours evidence.

Hydro employer history direct retrieval restricted; ABS historical evidence used. Obtain 1998 employment dates to distinguish pre/post 1 July reorganisation and overlap with Mackay/Bacon roles. No zero-year calculation from 1998–1998.

Full-time status remains unknown for all dated jobs. Need exact transitions, 1994–95 interval, any parental or study leave and concurrent roles. Childbirth and part-time study do not themselves establish unpaid leave or reduced employment hours. Unverified Young Labor presidency in 1996 retained as follow-up lead, not a paid-employment claim.

Follow-up: identify early supermarket and full-time employer; seek accessible 2023 profile or contemporary employment records; DTPHA staff establishment/annual reports; actual full-time and leave evidence for Health/Hydro and other jobs. Blocked is unresolved, not research complete.

Follow-up2026-10-02: identity-matched public LinkedIn profile inspected through index; no historical dates or hours exposed. Direct profile999not retried. Brisbane Times syndication of2023RachelClun profile returned InternalError/not accessible; no new early-employer evidence promoted. Search results repeating Wikipedia are not independent corroboration.

DTPHA2003–2005annual-report, staff-directory and ManagerSecretariat searches found budget structure, audit summary and TMAG subdepartmental report leads, but no attributable appointment instrument or employment-status evidence. Previously recorded TasmanianTimes directory lead remains unresolved; salary does not prove full-time. Early supermarket identity, full-time-job continuity, DTPHA appointment class, Hydro dates and leave remain priorities. This pass added no material employment fact; excluded from materially enriched counts.

Recovered local diagnostic error: git status issued from scratch parent returned128/not a git repository; no repository mutation attempted by that command. Subsequent validation uses the explicit repository root.

Follow-up2026-10-04: exact-title searches for the2023Sydney Morning Herald profile continued to expose only derivative summaries saying the later full-time role was at the same local supermarket; the source itself returned a non-retryable open error and no independent primary corroboration was found. That claim was not promoted or used to merge the two early spells. Targeted DTPHA ministerial-unit and Hydro searches supplied no appointment class, person-specific dates, hours or leave. No material change; preserve the unknown early employer and departmental classification and advance.

Follow-up2026-10-04: Tested independent ABC/personal-site first-job indexing and direct publisher-indexed2023profile searches. No person-specific new primary corroboration of later supermarket employer or DTPHA appointment class emerged; derivative copies repeated the same claim and a Woolworths network-planning namesake was rejected. Prior inaccessible profile was not bypassed. Keep separate school-age part-time supermarket episode and expressly full-time post-school episode until employer linkage supported. New retrieval plan: original departmental2003–05ministerial-unit organisational/staff chart, and independent contemporary personal interview; do not re-run derivative supermarket summaries as if new evidence.
